strategy.objective: Express soft, mobile volume as the visible proof of the fictional product proposition.

strategy.tension: Volumizing products are expected to trade movement for stiffness.
strategy.proposition: Visible lift that still moves like you.
strategy.desired_response: Read movement as premium product proof rather than styling spectacle.

principles: Use one short declarative proof line.
Let the visible motion carry more meaning than explanatory body copy.
Keep the tone composed, exact, and premium without category cliches.

The fictional Northstar AirLift bottle remains the stable brand anchor.
